title: Calendar build-vs-buy audit — 2026-08-08
summary: Decides to keep the bespoke BigCalendar over FullCalendar, Schedule-X, and react-big-calendar, and to extract it as a standalone project later.
notes: Type set by MANIFEST_TYPE=ADR (manifest_override=true). Content has a dated decision section ('Decision (2026-08-08, Ayoub)') with rationale and alternatives, matching ADR shape. No explicit Status field, so locked=false (only Accepted ADRs are locked). Filename lacks ADR numbering. Output filename lacks the SHA-256 path hash suffix because the classifier had no hashing tool; rename to {slug}-{sha256(source_path)[0:8]}.json before synthesis.
